<!-- pr-reviewer: dd46bd0483452df3b521f07d7a7e9d9e9e18f784 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The code checks passed. One required item is missing from the PR body.

What passed:
- Ribbon cells and menu rows have labels, roles, and state data. Workspace tabs have the Tab role and selected state.
- The changed tests use node labels to operate the ribbon. Their checks for commands and undo remain.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, or golden file changed.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239`:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files --test waterjet_tool -- --test-threads=6`, from `crates/ui`: passed. The library had 858 passed and 6 ignored. The five test suites had 3, 6, 2, 14, and 1 passed. No test failed. All six new AccessKit tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The gate plan was read with `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`. It includes unrelated changes from main. The checks above cover this PR's UI changes.

Required before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1147` (evidence in the PR body): Add before and after screenshots for the UI changes. The body has no screenshots. This diff includes the ribbon height and ink changes from #2027. Show Horizon Day and Teal Night at 1280 x 720, with the tabs, cells, and captions visible. Issue #2021 also requires these images. Put the images only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from this PR body. Do not add images to the PR branch.

Notes:
- This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision and gouge checks. No safety mutation run was required. I did not repeat the author's mutations or change the code.
- No goldens moved. The six ignored tests were not run. No GitHub runner was used.
- The PR remains a draft until the required evidence is present.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the review's missing screenshot evidence.

The PR body now shows Horizon Day and Teal Night before and after the ribbon height and ink changes. All four images are 1280 × 720 and show the tabs, cells, and captions. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `9a0cbde53f3698703052796e98327a51b0a6db86`.

The external evidence pin, `pr2081-check-evidence.py`, checks all four links, PNG dimensions, and image bytes. Removing a required link made it RED. Restoring the link made it GREEN. The published body passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The code head remains `dd46bd0483452df3b521f07d7a7e9d9e9e18f784`. Plain push reported everything up to date. This fix changed only PR evidence. No files were committed to the PR branch.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence. The PR remains a draft.

Code and evidence review clean. The branch now conflicts with main.

This is a second review of the same head. The later evidence comment answers the earlier finding.
I withdraw the screenshot change request from my earlier review. No blocking code or evidence findings remain.

Evidence checked:
- The PR body has before and after images for Horizon Day and Teal Night.
- All four links return valid PNG files at 1280 x 720. I inspected each image.
- The tabs, cells, and captions are visible. The after images show clear icon ink and space between the ribbon rows.

- The PR head has no screenshot files, changed goldens, new dependencies, or build script changes.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. The plan also includes unrelated changes from main.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files --test waterjet_tool -- --test-threads=6`, from `crates/ui`: passed.

No posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, collision check, or gouge check changed. No safety mutation run was required.
I did not repeat the author's mutations. No goldens moved. The six ignored library tests were not run.

Final merge check: upstream/main moved during this review to `42438238cd7900b5d413b9b84720e0a691401d04`.
A new trial merge has a content conflict in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`.
The test results above apply to the earlier clean trial merge, not this conflicted tree.
The PR gets `conflicts` and needs a branch refresh at merge time.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh (AGENTS.md "Refresh only at merge time"): this PR is in the next merge batch. Its parent #2027 has merged, so the conflict is only main moving. Requested change for the mergefix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch (no rebase), keep both sides, re-run the quick gate, push, and ask for a re-review. No other changes.

Merged `upstream/main` at `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824` into the branch. No rebase was used.

The conflict resolution keeps the AccessKit helper and both test modules. It keeps main's configurable label floor and removes the obsolete constant.

The merge also required an `AiChat` arm in the panel test helper. The existing `view_dropdown_rows_expose_menu_items` test now checks the AI Chat row.

Pins and mutation results:
- The external `pr2081-merge-pin.py` checks the merge requirements. Six mutations each gave RED, then GREEN after restoration.
- The dropdown test gave RED with an incorrect AI Chat label. It gave GREEN after restoration.
- Main's label floor and AI Chat posting refusal tests passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. The library had 912 passed and 6 ignored. All six integration suites passed.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN. The compile cache stalled, so the successful run used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.

New head: `dc426aed2eeb22de0f69d7c2f264d5d7b7129d7e`.

The PR is a draft. No labels were changed. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed to the PR branch.

Please re-review the merge resolution and the test compatibility fix.

Needs changes before merge.

The merge resolution keeps the AccessKit helper, both test modules, and main's configurable label floor. The AI Chat match arm is complete.
The earlier screenshot request is met. I checked all four PNG links and inspected the images. Each image is 1280 x 720. The tabs, cells, and captions are visible in both themes.

Requested before merge:
1. Complete the ribbon test conversion in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs:41` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_properties.rs:107`. The AI Chat helper still computes the Panels button and menu row positions. The tool catalog test still computes the Tools cell position and clicks it twice. Use the Button nodes named `Panels` and `Tools`, and the MenuItem node named `AI Chat`. Keep the existing behaviour checks. These tests came from main, but the final tree still fails #1988's explicit condition: no behaviour test computes a ribbon cell position. The PR body also says that only the two layout tests still use this geometry.

Local results with upstream/main at `af83da0f405cfd244f0c9bf8192ab7309e9db824`:
- Trial merge: clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. It selected the UI library and six integration suites.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: final run passed, 912 passed and 6 ignored. All six new AccessKit tests passed.
- Integration suites passed: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, sinker_setup 2, tap_hand 3, theme_files 14, waterjet_tool 1.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Direct cargo commands used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`. Each command ran in the foreground in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

Test limitation:
The first library run had 911 passes and one failure. The AI Chat posting test also failed in two isolated runs on this head. The same test passed once and failed once on upstream/main. The complete repeated library run on this head passed. This is an intermittent failure on main, not an additional blocker for this PR.

Failure text at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs:84`:
```text
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4).
Repaint causes: egui-0.36.2/src/containers/scroll_area.rs:1524
```

No posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, collision check, or gouge check changes. No goldens move. No dependency or build script changes. No safety mutation checks were required or run. No PR code was changed.

The review used upstream/main's current AGENTS.md. The PR head is unchanged and GitHub reports MERGEABLE. Set `needs-rework` for the incomplete test conversion. Keep the PR as a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Complete the ribbon test conversion from the latest review.

- The AI Chat helper now clicks the `Panels` Button and the `AI Chat` MenuItem. The existing `view_door_opens_ai_chat_tab_beside_properties_with_expected_controls` test passes. Its behavior checks remain. The unused coordinate helper was removed.
- The tool catalog test now clicks the `Tools` Button for both actions. The existing `tools_ribbon_opens_a_docked_catalog_without_retargeting_properties` test passes. Its behavior checks remain.

Evidence: Reverting each file made the external conversion pin RED. Restoring each file made it GREEN. Incorrect node labels made each behavior test RED. Restoring the labels made each test GREEN.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. The library had 912 passed and 6 ignored. All six selected integration suites passed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.

New head: `c004a5760acee6d746b6c995672cca3c5239d0c2`.

Please re-review these two test conversions. The PR remains a draft. No labels were changed.

Code review clean. Current upstream main has a separate build failure.

The earlier change requests are met:
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs:26` uses the `Panels` Button and the `AI Chat` MenuItem. The behaviour checks remain and pass.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_properties.rs:107` uses the `Tools` Button for both actions. The behaviour checks remain and pass.
- Only the two plan-only layout tests still compute ribbon geometry. The PR adds six tests and removes none.
- The merge resolution keeps the AccessKit helper, both test modules, and main's configurable label floor.
- The body has before and after images for Horizon Day and Teal Night. All four links return valid 1280 x 720 PNGs. I inspected each image. The tabs, cells, and captions are visible. The images are on the fork's screenshot branch.

Local trial merge with upstream/main at `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41`:
- The merge is clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` passed. Its plan includes unrelated main changes. I selected the UI suites from the PR diff.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` failed before tests could run.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` failed with the same error.

The error is:
```text
error[E0004]: non-exhaustive patterns: `camcraft_app::machine::Kind::Waterjet` not covered
  --> crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43:11
```
I also built upstream/main alone in this review worktree. It failed with the same error.
Both files involved are identical between the trial merge and upstream/main.
This PR does not change either file. This is a confirmed main failure, not a new finding against this PR.
The trial merge has no passing build or test result. Main needs a repair before merged validation can pass.

Additional local checks on the PR head alone, without the trial merge:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test tap_hand --test theme_files --test waterjet_tool -- --test-threads=6`, from `crates/ui`: passed.
- Library: 912 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. This includes the six AccessKit tests and both requested conversions.
- Integration suites: boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, sinker_setup 2, tap_hand 3, theme_files 15, waterjet_tool 1 passed. No test failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Direct cargo commands used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`. All commands ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested changes to this PR: none. The previous requests are cleared on this new head.

No safety mutation checks were required. I did not repeat the author's mutations or change PR code.
No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed in this PR.
